---
title: "Personal Visualization Journey"
---

```{r}
# uploading data
install.packages("readr")
library(readr)
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)

health <- read_csv("apple_health_records.csv")

view(health)
```
```{r}
# see which types of health data are available
health |>
  count(type, sort = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# calculate daily step counts
steps_daily <- health |>
  filter(type == "HKQuantityTypeIdentifierStepCount") |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(startDate), value = as.numeric(value)) |>
  group_by(date) |>
  summarize(steps = sum(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(
    day_of_week = wday(date, label = TRUE, week_start = 1),
    day_type = if_else(
      day_of_week %in% c("Sat", "Sun"),
      "Weekend",
      "Weekday"
    )
  )
```

```{r}
# examine the resulting dataset
summary(steps_daily)
```

```{r}
# initial visualization 
ggplot(steps_daily, aes(x = date, y = steps)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_smooth(se = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "My Daily Step Count Over Time",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Total Steps per Day",
    caption = "Source: Personal Apple Health export"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# calculate median step count for each day
median_labels <- steps_daily %>%
  group_by(day_of_week) %>%
  summarize(median_steps = median(steps, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
```

```{r}
# Identify the date range
start_date <- min(steps_daily$date, na.rm = TRUE)
end_date <- max(steps_daily$date, na.rm = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# multivariate visualization 
ggplot(steps_daily, aes(x = day_of_week, y = steps)) +
  geom_boxplot(
    aes(fill = day_type),
    outlier.size = 1.2,
    outlier.alpha = 0.25,
    show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
  geom_text(data = median_labels, aes(x = day_of_week, y = median_steps, label = scales::comma(round(median_steps))),
    vjust = -0.8,
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 3,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Weekday" = "#D55E00","Weekend" = "#0072B2")) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_number(scale = 0.001, suffix = "k")) +  
  labs(
    title = "Median Daily Step Counts by Day of the Week",
    subtitle = paste("TBD"),
    
    ## Reword the current title ("Do I Walk More on Weekends or Weekdays?") as a full sentence answering the question then put it in the subtitle as a takeaway message.
    
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    fill = "Day Type",
    caption = paste("Author: Abigail Heuga | Data Source: Personal Apple Health export", "| Dates :", format(start_date, "%b %d, %Y"), "–", format(end_date, "%b %d, %Y")),
    alt = "Boxplots comparing daily step counts by day of the week from January 15, 2018, to October 27, 2026. Median steps are 3,133 on Monday, 3,256 on Tuesday, 3,279 on Wednesday, 3,446 on Thursday, 3,996 on Friday, 2,786 on Saturday, and 2,293 on Sunday. Weekday step counts are generally higher than weekend step counts, with Friday having the highest median and Sunday the lowest."
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank()
  )
```
